Title: The Voyages & Travels of the Ambassadors from the Duke of Holstein to the Great Duke of Muscovy and the King of Persia, begun in the year M.DC.XXXIII and finished in M.DC.XXXIX: containing a complete history of Muscovy, Tartary, Persia and other adjacent countries, in seven books; whereto are added the Travels of John Albert de Mandelslo into the East Indies, in three books
Creator: Adam Olearius (Oelschlaeger), secretary of the embassy; rendered into English by John Davies of Kidwelly; Mandelslo's Travels added
Publisher: London: printed for Thomas Dring and John Starkey
Publication Date: 1662 (title-page OCR reads 'M. DC. LXK', that is MDCLXII; the host catalogue gives 1662)
Rights: Public Domain (printed 1662; Internet Archive licence URL: Public Domain Mark 1.0)
Source: Internet Archive item voyagestravelsolearius, file voyagestravelsolearius_djvu.txt (Google Books scan, 'Digitized by Google' on the pages; Internet Archive HTML5 Uploader), fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session, VI.23 world agent), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Public Domain Mark 1.0); no possible-copyright-status field; year 1662 from the host catalogue and the title page (partly misread by the OCR)
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged. The OCR reads the printed long s as 'f' throughout (for example 'Mufcovy' for Muscovy) and I did not normalise it, because 'f' for 's' cannot be reversed by a mechanical rule without risking real f's; nothing retyped, dropped or corrected. Rights basis restated: a book printed in London in 1662 is public domain by date.
